title: VINEYARD Plugin Manifest
description: A vineyard:plugin document. Same naming family as vineyard:typepack. Source of truth for the plugin (the legacy Plugin table is removed).

icon.description: Icon shown in the node right-click menu.

latest_url.description: Per-author fallback pointer to the always-newest manifest (update check).

platforms.description: Per-platform execution flags. At least one of web/desktop. 'primary' is preferred.

runtime.description: sandbox-js = author JS in the browser worker; web-proxy = thin client calling ONE author endpoint.

proxy_endpoint.description: REQUIRED when runtime=web-proxy. The ONE endpoint; MUST equal the single scopes.network entry.

io.description: Entity types referenced from typepacks. Empty consumes => whole-graph plugin (global launch).

params.description: JSON-Schema (draft 2020-12) for the pre-run form. Becomes Task.input. MUST NOT contain secrets (use scopes.config secret:true).

scopes.description: The plugin's authority surface. ctx members are absent unless granted. Enforced by the sandbox; graph writes are additionally held for the analyst's review before they are applied.

graph.description: Fine-grained node/edge verbs. Backed by the project graph_edit tier.

web_probe.description: DESKTOP ONLY. An anonymous request to an arbitrary public host, performed by the shell's main process (no cookies, no Origin, no redirects, private/loopback addresses refused). Backs ctx.net.probe. In the web build the capability is declared but has no backing, so ctx.net.probe stays absent and the plugin must fall back.

network.description: External XHR targets. WEB: exactly ONE entry == platforms.web.proxy_endpoint (no fan-out). Desktop: more allowed, user's responsibility.

services.description: Vineyard-operated services this plugin calls by NAME through ctx.service — never by URL. An ENUM rather than a free string on purpose: a name is a published contract, so a typo must fail at review rather than at the analyst's first run, and a scope the install gate shows must be one that can actually work. Different in kind from `network`: the destination is fixed by the host, and the analyst's identity is attached to the call, so a service scope is not covered by scopes_summary.network.

config.description: Install-time values injected at runtime only. secret:true = keychain/desktop, never returned to the browser, never recorded.

long_running.description: If true, the runtime continuously manages the task (status/pause/resume/cancel/retry/progress).

persistence.description: ephemeral = no Task DB row, current browser only.

states.description: Canonical 7-state machine. Retry mints a NEW task (not a state).

typeRef.description: Reference to a typepack node type. Node.type at runtime = '<category>.<name>'.

as.description: Optional binding alias; the consumed node's value is pre-bound into params under this key.

endpoint.description: Exact origin/path prefix; no cross-host wildcards.

secret.description: BYOK-style. Web: discouraged -> guide to desktop. Never written to any record.

distribution.description: Shared distribution block (plugin + typepack). No server-side copy; the client caches the fetched bundle locally.

ref.description: IMMUTABLE: 40-char commit SHA or annotated tag. Branches rejected by registry CI.

path.description: Path to manifest.json within repo@ref (git kind).

integrity.description: OPTIONAL. Light supply-chain hygiene only (detect a force-push at install). Not evidentiary.
